maes-1.why: Simultaneous equations require logical thinking and pattern recognition skills.

maes-2.why: Decimals are straightforward once basic operations are mastered.

maes-3.why: Determining angles is a fundamental geometry skill that can be practiced effectively.

maes-4.why: Algebra problems involve applying formulas and understanding relationships between variables.

maes-5.why: Trigonometry builds on algebra and geometry concepts with additional functions.

maes-6.why: Calculating area and volume involves applying geometric principles to real-world scenarios.

maes-7.why: Sketching curves requires visualization skills developed through practice in math and art.

maes-8.why: Working with fractions is essential for understanding ratios and proportions.

maes-9.why: Finding missing side lengths involves using theorems like Pythagorean theorem.
